title: data_analysis.ready (v1)
description: DataAnalysisAgent has finished analyzing the uploaded external dataset and frozen an ExternalDataAnalysisReport into the Research Store (see agents/data_analysis_agent/data-contracts/external_data_analysis_report.schema.yaml). Payload is intentionally minimal: the report is read from the Research Store by ref.

external_data_analysis_report_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ExternalDataAnalysisReport object.

consensus_status.description: Whether the analyzed trajectories converged on a consensus conclusion or diverged.
